verse.verse_1: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
verse.verse_2: By the Day as it appears in glory;
verse.verse_3: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
verse.verse_4: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
verse.verse_5: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
verse.verse_6: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
verse.verse_7: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
verse.verse_8: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
verse.verse_9: And gives the lie to the best,-
verse.verse_10: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
verse.verse_11: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
verse.verse_12: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
verse.verse_13: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
verse.verse_14: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
verse.verse_15: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
verse.verse_16: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
verse.verse_17: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
verse.verse_18: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
verse.verse_19: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
verse.verse_20: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
verse.verse_21: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
